mutations.because: The collector used to treat any `.log` in a wave directory as a lane, and one session's 442-file root of gate rounds, fix-runner transcripts and probe logs rendered as 113 lanes. Dropping the artefact-name rule resurrects exactly that behaviour: the fixture that reproduces the owner's root must then yield one phantom lane per file, and the zero-lanes assertion fails.

`vanished` must mean something bad — a run that ended or a terminal claim with no PR. A lane whose last words were `started`, with no EXIT and no PR, is a missing measurement, and collapsing this arm back into the old silence-default accuses it of vanishing — the lie that put 102 rows on the page at once.
command: a started event with nothing after it is unknown
